newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA PLANS A$650 MLN SHARE BUYBACK.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA PLANS A$650 MLN SHARE BUYBACK.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday it was planning a A$650 million buyback of its own shares.
"Directors have decided to reduce equity by way of a A$650 million share buyback," the bank said in a statement accompanying its 1996/97 (July/June) results.
The buyback would take place after the final Instalment Receipt payments were made in November.
"The decision to proceed with the proposed buyback will be confirmed in November, provided there is no material adverse change in the bank's current or prospective capital position," it said.
Directors also ended the discount on the bank's dividend reinvestment plan, starting with the 1998 interim dividend.
Several of Australia's big banks have instituted share buyback programmes as part of active capital management policies.
